title: NotchCue
description: Native macOS teleprompter that places private notes around the MacBook camera notch. Keeps eye contact during calls, demos and recordings.
problem: Notes sit away from the camera, which breaks eye contact during calls and demos.
system: Prompts live around the MacBook notch with a focused reading surface.
artifact: Product site and app concept built around the camera area.
outcome: Speakers keep structure without sounding like they are reading.
